acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: subsequently carbamidomethylated with 20 mM IAA (Sigma Aldrich, I6125-5G) for 30 min at RT in the dark

alkylation_reagent.evidence: subsequently carbamidomethylated with 20 mM IAA (Sigma Aldrich, I6125-5G) for 30 min at RT in the dark

cleavage_agent.evidence: Samples were pre-digested for 90 min at 37°C with Lys-C (FUJIFILM Wako Pure Chemical Corporation, 125-02543) at an enzyme-to-substrate ratio of 1:100
digested overnight at 37°C with sequencing grade trypsin (Trypsin Gold, Mass Spec Grade, Promega, V5280) at an enzyme-to-substrate ratio of 1:50

enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphorylated peptides were enriched using TiO2.

fractionation_method.evidence: 10%TFA was used to adjust the pH of the mix to less than 7 before neutral pH fractionation was performed using a 60 min gradient of 4.5 to 45% ACN (VWR, 83639.320) in 10 mM ammonium formate

labeling.evidence: 450 μg of each TMT pro reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific) were dissolved in 30 μl of 100% anhydrous acetonitrile

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: coupled to an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher)

reduction_concentration.evidence: reduced with 10 mM DTT (Roche, 10197777001) for 45 min at RT

reduction_reagent.evidence: reduced with 10 mM DTT (Roche, 10197777001) for 45 min at RT
